# GEOrent — Car Rental in Batumi, Georgia

> GEOrent is a local car rental company based in Batumi, Georgia. We rent reliable, well-maintained cars for daily trips, vacations and travel across Georgia, with delivery to Batumi and Tbilisi airports, full CASCO insurance and fast WhatsApp booking. Cars from $45/day. We also operate in Tbilisi and offer VIP transfers.

## Key facts
- Company: GEOrent (also written GEOrent Car Rental)
- Website: https://geo-rent.com
- Location: Lermontov Street 101, Batumi, Georgia
- Service areas: Batumi, Tbilisi, and across Georgia
- Fleet: 50+ cars — SUVs, sedans, minivans, convertibles, electric and luxury cars
- Prices: from $45/day; lower daily rates for longer rentals
- Booking: WhatsApp +995 500 194 533, or the request form on the website
- Working hours: 09:00–22:00, 7 days a week
- Payment: cash

## Rental conditions
- Minimum driver age: 21 years
- Driving experience: 2+ years
- Refundable security deposit from $100
- Maximum renter liability for damage at fault: $100
- Documents: passport + physical driving license (foreign national licenses accepted, e.g. Israeli license; no IDP required)
- Insurance: full CASCO — covers windshield, windows, mirrors, roof, underbody and theft; only wheels and tires are excluded; third-party damage covered with no extra deductible
- CASCO is valid on paved and normal passable public gravel/unpaved roads; genuine off-road / 4x4 driving is not covered
- In an accident you must call the police (112) and GEOrent, and not move the car
- No mandatory cleaning fee; a wash fee (from 20 GEL) applies only if the car is returned unusually dirty

## Airport delivery prices
- Batumi Airport: $10 daytime, $25 at night
- Tbilisi Airport: $35 daytime, $50 at night
- Batumi city delivery: on request
